name: patchwork
description: PATCHWORK — Independent DOM patching, verification, and rollback platform

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace=packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/verification && npm run build --workspace=packages/verification && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/dashboard
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace=packages/verification && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/runtime && npm run build --workspace=packages/dashboard
